prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1498; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid shows a crease along its lower edge, with the tail lamp assembly broken on the driver side. The damage lines up with the impact as it was described, and no older damage to this vehicle is on record. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the rear panel to match. The labor hours listed are in line with work of this kind. The invoices submitted show no repeated charges for the same items.
